notes: Homonym: shares consonants and vowels אהל with H167 ("pitch a tent"), a separate, unrelated Strong's entry already in this dataset. H167's own notes flagged this exact collision in advance. Per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹), this root is now אהל¹ and H167 has been retroactively relabeled אהל² in the same batch.
